newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy basis offers down, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy basis offers down, corn steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis offers dropped by two to four cents a bushel, weighed down by higher CBOT soybean prices, dealers said.
Corn and wheat values were mostly steady.
CBOT soybeans rallied on Wednesday on persistent rumors that China was in the market for soybeans and on forecasts for harvest-impeding rain and snow in key U.S. growing regions.

Several U.S. exporters said they could not confirm the Chinese rumors. "It would not surprise me to see China in," a U.S. exporter said. "To be honest, I have not heard anything. But you probably never know for sure," he said.
On possible soymeal purchases, one U.S. vegoil trader said business was being done with China but he would not specify an amount.
